notes: ὅ τι is taken as one aligned unit on the single word as under rule 39's test; giving as to ὅ alone and leaving τι unrepresented remains defensible.
The supplied day belongs to the substantival numeral μίαν, the anarthrous Greek leaving no article to take it (rules 17, 58).
s015 μή keeps no because λογεῖαι is not itself a negative, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty the particle; s018 τότε has no English word at all.
